summary: Official Uttar Pradesh sources evidence a Tundla tehsil cadastral-map custodian and digitization status, and the public Bhunaksha viewer exposes a first-party service base. No bounded anonymous parcel ID plus polygon response was verified, so no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries are recorded in city-9049-tundla.json. They found the official UP Bhulekh portal, the Firozabad/Tundla georeferencing report, UP Revenue Department, IGRSUP property-registration services, and the public Bhunaksha viewer.
requestOutcomes: Browser-like GETs loaded the official Bhulekh, GeoDashboard, and Bhunaksha viewer pages. The viewer JavaScript exposed https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver and endpoints including Layers/getLayers, MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref, MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, MapInfo/getPlotByPlotNo, and api/plots. Direct base-path probes returned application errors or timed out; no GIS code, parcel feature list, native ID, geometry, schema, or CRS was retrieved.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [27.2202562931112, 78.2412484593598] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; it was not shifted and no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
The official report is tehsil/village/map-sheet status evidence, not proof of citywide vector coverage or completeness.
The report lists unavailable maps in Tundla tehsil; this does not establish parcel absence.
No parcel geometry or stable native parcel identity was obtained, so no GeoJSON sample is retained.
Timeouts, application errors, login/access restrictions, map extent misses, or an unusable UI are not treated as evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; independent serial reviewer qualification remains required.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
crs: unverified; no parcel geometry response obtained

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No usable parcel query response reached the geometry stage. The exact WUP point was preserved but no hit/miss inference was made.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: A village-specific viewer workflow, restricted API route, or formal/authenticated land-record route may provide additional data. Public availability, safe field schema, native identity semantics, CRS, parcel completeness, legal status, and city coverage remain unresolved.
